stages.name: Mandate
stages.decision: Why acquire instead of build, partner, or do nothing?
stages.evidence: A defined business need, capital envelope, risk limits, executive sponsor, and decision authority.
stages.judgment: Frame before detail. The target must serve the mandate.

stages.name: Thesis & Targets
stages.decision: What must be true, and which targets fit and can actually be bought?
stages.evidence: Thesis conditions, ranked target screen, pass rationale, ownership map, control path, and initial downside test.
stages.judgment: Underwrite rather than admire. Strategic appeal does not establish transactability.

stages.name: First Look & Underwriting
stages.decision: Do access, standalone economics, financing, and downside support a bid?
stages.evidence: Minimum information package, reconstructed financials, valuation range, financing case, and private price ceiling.
stages.judgment: Replicate the financials. Keep buyer-created synergy separate from standalone value.

stages.name: LOI & Diligence
stages.decision: Are core terms clear, and can the team test the conditions behind the thesis?
stages.evidence: Approved LOI, evidence requests, workflow tests, accountable workstream owners, and a live issue log.
stages.judgment: Unknowns are findings. Give each material issue a consequence: Investigate, Price, Protect, or Walk.
stages.gates: Gates 5–6 · Exclusivity approved and diligence launched

stages.name: Re-underwrite & Sign
stages.decision: Does the deal still work on the facts and terms now in front of the buyer?
stages.evidence: Revised valuation and synergy case, combined downside, final economics, protections, closing conditions, and integration owners.
stages.judgment: Re-establish the price ceiling before signing. Prior spending does not justify the next commitment.

stages.name: Close & Day 1
stages.decision: Can funds and control transfer while the business keeps working?
stages.evidence: Funds flow, required consents and clearances, closing checklist, and customer, cash, people, and system readiness.
stages.judgment: Protect revenue while integrating cost. Do not confuse signing with operating readiness.
stages.gates: Gates 9–10 · Closing approved and Day 1 stable
stages.resource: After the Deal: Keep the Business Working

stages.name: Value Delivery & Review
stages.decision: Has the buyer delivered the underwritten value, and what should change next time?
stages.evidence: 30/60/100-day reviews, realized cash benefits and costs, workflow decisions, revised forecasts, and residual action owners.
stages.judgment: Compare results with the original thesis. A synergy belongs in the results only when the operating work delivers it.
stages.gates: Gates 11–12 · Value delivery confirmed and program closed
